note: Hand-authored OBSERVED impact paths for major documented events. Each is digitised from published reporting and imagery and is approximate at the scale of a few hundred metres; it is not a survey product. Events without an entry here fall back to a modelled river trace in corridors.py.

properties.name: Langtang ice-rock avalanche → Bhote Koshi / Trishuli debris flow
properties.note: Approximate observed path of the 26 August 2026 cascade: several million m³ of ice and rock detached near 5,000 m in the Langtang area, fell ~1,900 m, briefly dammed the Bhote Koshi, then breached — sending a debris flow and flash flood roughly 100 km down the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli. Cross-border impact was reported at Gyirong (China). Digitised from USGS and UN OCHA reporting; approximate.
properties.reference: USGS 2026 Nepal Debris Avalanche and Flash Flood; UN OCHA situation reports, Aug 2026
